Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `testByteToStringVariations` in `Base64Test` is expecting the output of `Base64.encodeBase64String(b1)` to be equal to `"SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ="`. However, the current implementation of `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[] binaryData)` in the `Base64` class is incorrectly using chunking, causing the output to be different than expected. The bug report suggests changing the method to use `encodeBase64(binaryData, false)` instead of `encodeBase64(binaryData, true)` to disable chunking, which will fix the issue.

I will now inspect the relevant code snippets to further investigate the root cause of the bug.

messages.content: "128 :     public static byte[] getBytesUtf8(String string) {\n129 :         return StringUtils.getBytesUnchecked(string, CharEncoding.UTF_8);\n130 :     }"

The `encodeBase64String` method in the `Base64` class encodes binary data using the base64 algorithm into 76 character blocks separated by CRLF, which is causing the chunking issue. The method currently implements chunking by default when calling `encodeBase64(binaryData, true)`.

The `getBytesUtf8` method in the `StringUtils` class is used to get the UTF-8 byte array of a given string, as seen in the test method where `"Hello World"` is converted to a byte array using this method.

The fix for this issue involves changing the call to `encodeBase64(binaryData, false)` in the `encodeBase64String` method to disable chunking. This change will ensure that the output does not contain the chunking behavior, resolving the failing test case.

The root cause of the bug is the incorrect chunking behavior in the `encodeBase64String` method, which is not aligned with the expectations of the test case.

messages.name: get_code_snippet
messages.content: "782 :     public static byte[] encodeBase64(byte[] binaryData, boolean isChunked) {\n783 :         return encodeBase64(binaryData, isChunked, false);\n784 :     }"

The `encodeBase64` method in the `Base64` class is responsible for encoding binary data using the base64 algorithm with an option to enable or disable chunking. This method delegates its call to another `encodeBase64` method with additional parameters.

To fix the issue in the `encodeBase64String` method and disable chunking, the method should be modified to call `encodeBase64(binaryData, false)` instead of the current `encodeBase64(binaryData, true)`.

The best location to fix this issue is:
```
org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[], boolean)
```
